text: dsh-model-vision 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的视觉模型能力补全插件。它读取已配置网关公布的模型清单，把图片输入能力补回模型声明，并在模型名后标注“可看图”。插件启动后定时检查，也会在模型配置变化后重新对账；设置页提供手动检测按钮，网关没有声明能力时可发送纯色图片探测。适合希望在 DSH 中正确识别网关视觉模型的用户。探测请求会发送到用户配置的模型 API 地址，并使用该路由已有凭据。

dsh-model-vision helps DSH recognize vision-capable models. It reads gateway listings, restores image-input declarations and marks capable models. Background checks and a Settings button update declarations; optional probes send color images to the configured API using existing route credentials.
让 DSH 自动补上网关模型的图片输入能力。
模型明明支持看图，DSH 却提示不支持图片输入，怎么修？
How can I make DSH detect which configured models accept image input?
dsh-model-vision 的功能「同步视觉能力」：读取已配置网关的模型清单，并把模型是否接受图片写回 DSH 的输入类型声明。后台会定时检查，也会在配置变化后重新扫描。
dsh-model-vision 的功能「手动检测模型」：在设置的模型列表下方点击检测按钮，对网关未说明图片能力的模型发送纯色图片探测，并显示补充结果和明细。
dsh-model-vision 使用前须知：检查模型清单及可选视觉探测时，会向你配置的网关 API 发送请求；探测请求包含生成的纯色图片。
dsh-model-vision 使用前须知：插件不要求单独的 API key；请求会沿用对应模型路由配置的凭据，需由用户配置的 API 服务处理。

dsh-model-vision README · dsh-model-vision：**让 DSH 自动认出哪些模型能看图。** 中文 · [English](README.en.md) 能看图的模型自动勾上「输入类型：图片」，名字后面标出「· 可看图」—— 不用再手动一个个点，也不会下次点「获取可用模型」就被清掉。 不用装额外的命令行工具，不用另配一把 key，也不用换网关。 它只是把网关**本来就公布**的能力，补回 DSH 漏掉的那一格。 [](https://github.com/charovo0059/dsh-model-vision/actions/workflows/test.yml) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-model-vision) [](LICENSE) [](https://nodejs.org) [](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) [](https://github.com/charovo0059/dsh-model-vision/stargazers)

dsh-model-vision README · 你可能正遇到这些：- 贴了一张图，DSH 回「这个模型不支持图片输入」，或者图干脆被当没看见
- 网关的说明里明明写着某个模型支持图片，DSH 里它却没有「图片」这个选项
- 你手动勾过一次「图片」，下次再点「获取可用模型」，勾又被清掉了

**原因**：DSH 拉模型清单时只记下了名字、上下文长度和输出上限，**漏记了「能不能看图」**。
于是每个拉回来的模型都按默认值当成只能读文字，带图请求在附件阶段就被拒了。

这个插件把这一项补上。

> **适合**：你用第三方网关 / 中转站 / 自建服务（任何 OpenAI 兼容地址），并且想让模型能看图。
> **不适合**：模型本身就不吃图片。插件不会让只读文字的模型学会看图。

**它不做什么**（这样你能放心装）：

- 不会让只读文字的模型学会看图
- 不会替你填 API key，不会改模型名字（除了末尾那个标注）、上下文长度、价格
- 不会因为网关没说就自己猜一个能力
- 不连任何第三方服务器，不上传对话内容，没有遥测

text:
dsh-model-vision README · 怎么用：**装好就在后台干活，你什么都不用点。**

它会在三个时机自动对账：

| 时机 | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| DSH 启动后 3 秒 | 把已经配好的模型扫一遍，该勾的勾上 |
| 每次你点「获取可用模型」 | 5 秒内补齐新拉进来的模型 |
| 每 5 分钟 | 对一次账，上游换了能力也能跟上 |

想立刻检查一遍：

> **设置 → 模型** → 滚到模型列表最下面 → 点「检测并补充视觉能力」

点完就地出结果（一句话 + 「展开明细」），不用换页。

dsh-model-vision README · 它判断能力的顺序：1. **先看网关自己怎么写的** —— 写了就照它写，这一步很便宜，不花钱；
2. **网关没写的模型，才真的发图去问** —— 发一张纯色图问「这是什么颜色」，问两个不同颜色：
   - 答对了任意一个 → 能看图
   - 答成别的颜色（比如给它红色，它说 purple）→ 看不见图，判为只能读文字
   - 一个颜色都不提（回了一整段话）→ **没结论**，不写声明

**沉默不等于纯文本。** 网关没说、探测也没问出来，它就什么都不写——宁可不写，也不写错。

几个你会关心的事：

| 你可能会问 | 答案 |
|---|---|
| 会动我的勾选吗？ | 不会。只补「输入类型：图片」，模型还是你选的那些 |
| 会花很多额度吗？ | 只测网关没写能力的模型，每个最多两次很小的请求（64×64 纯色图）；单次最多 40 个，超出显示「跳过 N 个」 |
| 会重复测吗？ | 不会。结论会记住：能看图的记 7 天，不能的记 1 天 |
| 为什么有的模型「没结论」？ | 模型答非所问（比如回一整段话不提颜色）。这种**不会**被当成"只能读文字"，宁可不写也不写错 |

dsh-model-vision README · 支持哪些网关：只要能被 DSH 当供应商用，基本都能处理——它不假设路径和字段名。

| 你的服务 | 怎么找模型清单 | 能不能一键探测 |
|---|---|---|
| 官方 / 中转站（OpenAI 兼容） | `/models`，找不到就试 `/v1/models`、`/model/info` | ✅ |
| 自建 vLLM / LM Studio / one-api / new-api | 同上（`baseURL` 写不写 `/v1` 都行） | ✅ |
| Anthropic 协议（`/v1/messages`） | `/v1/models?limit=1000` | ✅ |
| Ollama | `/api/tags`（按模型名匹配） | ✅（要它自己答对才算） |
| Responses 协议（`/responses`） | `/models` | 只看清单，不探测（它的图片格式不一样，乱猜会误判） |

判断能力时它认哪些字段写法，见 [docs/how-it-works.md](docs/how-it-works.md)。

dsh-model-vision README · 怎么确认它在工作：**最直观的**：设置 → 模型 → 找一个你确定能看图的模型 → 点开「输入类型」→「图片」已经勾上了。

**看它留下的一句话**：每次干完活它会写一份记录，只看里面的 `message` 一行就够了：

```json
{
  "message": "扫了 58 个模型（网关报了 191 个），补了 34 个的「输入类型：图片」"
}
```

一共只会出现这几种话：

| `message` 说什么 | 意思 |
|---|---|
| 补了 N 个的「输入类型：图片」 | 正常干活，补了 N 个 |
| 没有要改的 | 正常，你配的模型都已经对上了 |
| 本来可以补 N 个……但只看不写模式（dryRun）开着 | 你把 `dryRun` 打开了，它只看不动 |
| 出错了：…… | 后面跟的就是原因 |
| 没有可检查的模型 | 还没配供应商，或者没点过「获取可用模型」 |

dsh-model-vision README · 会不会弄坏我的配置：- **只写「输入类型」这一个字段**，写完立刻停手
- 没有要改的 → **一个字节都不落盘**
- 写之前逐行比对，注释、字段顺序、`!!js` 表达式原样保留
- 万一写坏了：改之前先备份 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`，出问题直接覆盖回去
- 想让它只看不写：配置里加 `dryRun: true`，它照样记账，但不动你的文件

它碰什么：

| 它要 | 用来做什么 |
|---|---|
| 读你的配置文件 | 看每个模型现在声明的「输入类型」 |
| 写你的配置文件 | 只写 `input`（文字/图片）和模型名末尾的「· 可看图」 |
| 读本机凭据（`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs`） | 访问你自己填的那个 API 地址时要带 key |
| 访问你填的那个 API 地址 | 读模型清单；探测时发两张 64×64 纯色图 |

**不连任何第三方服务器**，不上传对话内容，不读你的会话记录，没有遥测。

dsh-model-vision README · 出问题怎么办：| 现象 | 先看哪 | 常见原因 |
|---|---|---|
| 某个模型没被勾上 | 状态记录里的 `held` | ① 你自己勾过"只要文字"，插件尊重你的选择 ② 网关没说明它支持图片 ③ 它确实只能读文字 |
| 一个都没勾上 | 状态的 `listed` 是不是 0 | 网关地址填错、服务没开，或者网关压根不公布模型清单 |
| 报 `401` | 状态的 `credential` | 没找到这家的 key。把 key 填进「模型」设置页，或确认网关不需要 key |
| 勾上了，贴图还是失败 | — | 网关说支持但实际不支持。把那个模型的「图片」取消掉，或去网关那边确认 |
| 模型名太长 / 不想看标注 | — | 配置里 `badgeSuffix: ''`，重启后标注会自己撤掉（它只摘自己加在末尾的那一段） |
| 改了 5 分钟才生效 | 状态的时间 | 正常节奏就是这样；想立刻生效就重启 DSH |
| 点了按钮报「超出上限跳过 N 个」 | 结果里的这行字 | 单次探测有上限（默认 40 个）。再点一次会接着测（已测过的不会重来），或把 `maxProbes` 调大 |
| 探测显示「没结论」 | 结果的这一行 | 模型没正面回答颜色。不会被误标成"只能读文字"，你手动勾一下即可 |
| 按钮不见了 | 设置 → 模型，列表最下面 | 先重启 DSH。如果某个 DSH 版本改了这个位置，插件会自动退成「设置 → 视觉能力」单页，功能相同 |
| 按钮说「后台服务没响应」 | — | 宿主半边没挂上，重启一次 DSH |

dsh-model-vision README · Introduction：

dsh-model-vision README · dsh-model-vision：**Lets DSH recognise which models can actually see images.**

Models that accept images get the "Image" input type checked automatically, and a
`· 可看图` marker after their name — no clicking through every model by hand, and
it survives the next "Fetch available models".

No extra CLI to install, no second API key, no need to switch gateways.
It only puts back a capability your gateway **already advertises** but DSH dropped.

dsh-model-vision README · dsh-model-vision：[](https://github.com/charovo0059/dsh-model-vision/actions/workflows/test.yml) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-model-vision) [](LICENSE) [](https://nodejs.org) [](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) [](https://github.com/charovo0059/dsh-model-vision/stargazers)

dsh-model-vision README · You may be hitting this：- You paste an image and DSH answers "this model does not support image input", or the image is silently ignored
- Your gateway's docs say a model takes images, but DSH shows no "Image" option for it
- You checked "Image" by hand once, and the next "Fetch available models" cleared it

dsh-model-vision README · You may be hitting this：**Why**: when DSH reads a model catalog it keeps only the name, context window and
output limit — it **drops the modality**. Every fetched model therefore falls back
to text-only, and an image request is rejected before it leaves the client.

This plugin puts that field back.

dsh-model-vision README · You may be hitting this：> **Good fit**: you use a third-party gateway / relay / self-hosted server (any
> OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and want image input to work.
> **Not a fit**: the model genuinely cannot see images. This plugin will not teach
> a text-only model to see.

**What it does not do** (so you can install it without worry):

dsh-model-vision README · You may be hitting this：- It does not make a text-only model see images
- It does not fill in API keys, and does not touch model names (except that trailing marker), context windows or pricing
- It does not guess a capability when the gateway says nothing
- It contacts no third-party host, uploads no conversation content, and has no telemetry

section: See what it would change before installing

text:
dsh-model-vision README · Usage：**It works in the background. You do not have to click anything.**

It reconciles at three moments:

| When | What |
|---|---|
| 3 s after DSH starts | Sweeps the models already configured and fills in what is missing |
| Every time you click "Fetch available models" | Fills in the newly fetched models within 5 s |
| Every 5 minutes | Reconciles again, so upstream capability changes are picked up |

To check right now:

dsh-model-vision README · Usage：> **Settings → Models** → scroll to the bottom of the model list → click **Detect and fill in vision capability**

The result appears in place (one sentence plus an expandable detail list).

dsh-model-vision README · How it decides：1. **Read what the gateway says first** — if it declares a modality, that wins. Cheap, and costs nothing.
2. **Only probe the models the gateway says nothing about** — send a solid-colour image and ask what colour it is, over two different colours:
   - Names a colour it was actually shown → it can see images
   - Names a different colour (shown red, answers "purple") → it cannot see images, recorded as text-only
   - Names no colour at all (answers with a paragraph) → **inconclusive**, nothing is written

dsh-model-vision README · How it decides：**Silence is not the same as text-only.** If the gateway is silent and the probe
is inconclusive, the plugin writes nothing — better nothing than wrong.

Questions you probably have:

dsh-model-vision README · How it decides：| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Will it change my selections? | No. It only fills in the "Image" input type; your model selection is untouched |
| Will it burn quota? | Only models whose capability the gateway did not declare, at most two tiny requests each (64×64 solid colour). At most 40 per run; beyond that it shows "skipped N" |
| Will it probe the same model again? | No. Verdicts are cached: 7 days for "yes", 1 day for "no" |
| Why is a model "inconclusive"? | The model did not answer the question (e.g. replied with a paragraph and named no colour). It is **not** treated as text-only — nothing is written rather than something wrong |
dsh-model-vision README · Supported gateways：Anything DSH can use as a provider should work — it does not assume paths or field names.

dsh-model-vision README · Supported gateways：| Your service | How the model list is found | One-click probe |
|---|---|---|
| Official / relay (OpenAI-compatible) | `/models`, falling back to `/v1/models`, `/model/info` | ✅ |
| Self-hosted vLLM / LM Studio / one-api / new-api | same (with or without `/v1` in `baseURL`) | ✅ |
| Anthropic protocol (`/v1/messages`) | `/v1/models?limit=1000` | ✅ |
| Ollama | `/api/tags` (matched by model name) | ✅ (only if it answers correctly) |
| Responses protocol (`/responses`) | `/models` | List only, no probing (its image format differs; guessing would misfire) |

dsh-model-vision README · Supported gateways：For the exact field names it understands, see [docs/how-it-works.md](docs/how-it-works.md).

text:
dsh-model-vision README · Will it break my config：- **It writes one field only** — the input type — and stops there
- Nothing to change → **not a byte is written**
- It compares line by line before writing, so comments, field order and `!!js` expressions survive
- If something ever goes wrong: back up `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` first, restore it to roll back
- To watch without writing: set `dryRun: true`; it still records, but touches no file

What it touches:

dsh-model-vision README · Will it break my config：| It needs | Used for |
|---|---|
| Read your config | See the input type each model currently declares |
| Write your config | Only `input` (text/image) and the `· 可看图` suffix on the model name |
| Read local credentials (`refs` in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`) | To authenticate against the API endpoint you configured |
| Reach that API endpoint | Read the model list; send two 64×64 solid-colour images when probing |

dsh-model-vision README · Will it break my config：**No third-party host is contacted**, no conversation content is uploaded, no
session history is read, and there is no telemetry.

dsh-model-vision README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Look at | Likely cause |
|---|---|---|
| A model is not checked | `held` in the status record | ① You marked it text-only yourself; the plugin respects that ② The gateway does not declare image support ③ It really is text-only |
| Nothing is checked | Whether `listed` is 0 | Wrong endpoint, service down, or the gateway publishes no model list |
| `401` | `credential` in the status record | No key found for this route. Add it in Settings → Models, or confirm the gateway needs none |
| Checked, but image requests still fail | — | The gateway claims support it does not have. Uncheck "Image" for that model, or ask the gateway operator |
| Model names too long / no marker wanted | — | Set `badgeSuffix: ''`; the marker is removed after a restart (it only strips the suffix it added) |
| Changes take 5 minutes to appear | `updatedAt` | That is the normal cadence; restart DSH to apply immediately |
| "Skipped N over the limit" | That line in the result | There is a per-run probe cap (default 40). Click again to continue (already-probed models are not retried), or raise `maxProbes` |
| A model shows "inconclusive" | That line in the resul

dsh-model-vision README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-model-vision
```

Restart DSH and it is gone — `dsh plugin remove` also drops it from
`dsh.profile.bundles`, so no manual config editing is needed.

The "Image" checkboxes that were filled in stay — they are now ordinary entries in
your own config and the plugin does not roll them back. Uncheck them in the
settings page if you want them gone.

dsh-model-vision README · Configuration (usually unnecessary)：It works out of the box. To tune it, add an override in
`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`. **The `name` line must be exactly
`dsh-model-vision`**, otherwise the entry is skipped silently:

```yaml
- id: model-vision
  name: dsh-model-vision
  config:
    mode: fill               # fill = only fill gaps (default); sync = also correct a stale declaration
